CashflowBandConstraint.description:
Levels the recurring cashflow targets of every account on the strategy:
each live bucket of a recurring target is held within
±max_deviation_ratio of that target's post-trade mean bucket cashflow,
in raw dollars, while the objective is still maximized. Buckets with
an amount override are left out of the band, as are one_time targets
and targets with fewer than two remaining buckets. Assigned accounts
inherit it; per-account customizations may override or remove it by
id.

id.description: Unique identifier for this constraint. Must match the `constraint_id` on the enclosing `ConstraintOperation`. Required.
id.title: ID

constraint_priority.description: Same as ConstraintPriority, but omitted defaults to 1, so the band relaxes before the cashflow floors (tier 2).

max_deviation_ratio.description: Half-width of the band as a fraction of the target's mean bucket, in (0, 1].
max_deviation_ratio.title: Max Deviation Ratio

Discriminator union of all constraint variants. The `id` field on

the resolved variant. (Removing the redundant parent-level `id`

union instead of intersection wrappers.)

SellPrecedenceConstraint.description: Enforces a trading-precedence ordering across an ordered list of security groups. Each entry in `filters` selects a group (the in-scope securities matching it); a group may only be traded once every higher-precedence (earlier) group has been fully consumed. Earlier filters are higher precedence. At least two filters are required — a single-group ordering is a no-op.

id.title: ID

filters.description: Ordered list of group-membership filters. Index 0 is the highest-precedence group. At least two filters are required.
filters.title: Filters

TradeConstraint.description: A trade constraint that limits trade sizes by notional value, par value, or portfolio weight. Exactly one minimum must be specified: either min_size or min_weight (not both). Max fields are optional, but max_size and max_weight cannot both be specified. Mutual exclusivity is per bound — you can mix across bounds (e.g., min_size with max_weight is valid). Weight fields must be in the range 0-1 (representing 0-100% of portfolio value).

id.description: Unique identifier for this constraint. Must match the `constraint_id` on the enclosing `ConstraintOperation`. Required.

max_size.description: The maximum size of the trade, measured in the unit given by `size_basis` (market value or par). Cannot be specified together with max_weight.
max_size.title: Max Size

max_weight.description: The maximum size of the trade as a percentage of the portfolio value (0-1). Cannot be specified together with max_size.
max_weight.title: Max Weight

min_size.description: The minimum size of the trade, measured in the unit given by `size_basis` (market value or par). Either min_size or min_weight must be specified. Cannot be specified together with min_weight.
min_size.title: Min Size

min_weight.description: The minimum size of the trade as a percentage of the portfolio value (0-1). Either min_size or min_weight must be specified. Cannot be specified together with min_size.
min_weight.title: Min Weight
